status.evidence_basis: which resource is listed first and which one served the last recorded completion. Configuration - what is configured, declared or reachable; below level 1 and not a statement about behaviour
status.mode_note: mode follows the most recent completion that actually SERVED (a successful recorded row) when history exists, prediction only until then — the two disagree when a listed model keeps failing, or is disabled by configuration and skipped
status.floor_active_basis: no successful completion has been recorded yet; predicted from whether a real model is listed
status.floor_note: The deterministic native floor is serving — honest structured reasoning, NOT an LLM. Run a local Ollama model (or enable an external accelerant) for generative prose.
status.guarantee: Workstation always produces a real, structured result from its OWN resources with NO external dependency; external providers are optional accelerants (flag-gated by AI_ALLOW_EXTERNAL).
